# Gabs Utilities

Gabs Utilities is a public product and tool catalog by Gabriel García Alonso,
a Berlin-based sound engineer, producer and developer-oriented creator.

## Primary pages

- Shop and theme gallery: https://gabs-utilities.com/
- Free WAV delivery handoff checklist: https://gabs-utilities.com/audio-delivery-checklist.html
- Audio Delivery Preflight CLI: https://gabs-utilities.com/audio-delivery-preflight-cli.html
- Audio Delivery Preflight CLI sample report: https://gabs-utilities.com/audio-delivery-preflight-sample-report.html
- Impressum: https://gabs-utilities.com/impressum.html

## Commercial audio utility

Audio Delivery Preflight CLI is a local, read-only command-line checker for
bounced WAV delivery folders before client, label or release handoff. It is
sold via Gumroad for EUR 19:

https://notgabriel.gumroad.com/l/audio-delivery-preflight-cli

It is not automatic mastering, a distributor-submission validator, a cloud
upload service or a replacement for human listening.

The free checklist gives a manual studio handoff process before purchase:

https://gabs-utilities.com/audio-delivery-checklist.html

The sample report demonstrates the style of output and example findings before
purchase:

https://gabs-utilities.com/audio-delivery-preflight-sample-report.html
